Centreon Plugins — schema references

Format of the JSON collection files consumed by the centreon-plugin-rust-snmp binary, generated from the JSON Schema files of the centreon-plugins repository, on every change to the develop branch. One reference per format version: a collection keeps validating against the version it was written for.

Each reference above serves its own machine-readable rs-collection.schema.json: point the $schema key of a collection at that URL to get completion in your editor. The URL carries the format version, and a published one never changes.
